name: Enhanced Weapons
author: Moritz Wallinger
description: Enhanced RAC weapon visuals and optional V1-V5/Omega progression; automatically defers gameplay progression to Arsenal Mastery when both are loaded.

settings.name: Weapon XP
settings.description: Level supported combat weapons from V1 through V5 to OMEGA.

settings.name: Enhanced RAC weapon HUD
settings.description: Show the equipped weapon in the Enhanced RAC Style with tier badge, segmented progression and XP bar.

settings.name: XP rate
settings.description: Multiplier applied to weapon XP earned from shots and hits.

settings.name: Tier damage upgrades
settings.description: Apply the V2-V5/Omega damage bonuses to supported weapon hits.

settings.name: Level-up notice
settings.description: Show a large HUD message whenever a weapon reaches a new tier.

settings.name: Hit marker
settings.description: Show a brief marker when your wrench or weapon hits a moby.

settings.name: Marker style
settings.description: Choose the in-game hit marker style.

settings.name: Marker duration
settings.description: How many game ticks the hit marker remains visible.

settings.name: Projectile heat haze
settings.description: Add subtle heat distortion around known player mines, bombs and missiles; higher weapon tiers intensify it slightly.

settings.name: Heat haze strength
settings.description: Base strength of the projectile distortion.
